prompt: Extract only source-grounded SENF advisory features. Never emit canonical symbols, predicates, logical atoms, roles, statements, or PLN. Every extraction text must be an exact mention substring. Use senf_feature with attributes name and value for mention_type (proper, common, pronoun, nominal), definiteness (definite, indefinite, demonstrative, pronoun, unknown), registered exemplar cues, and modality/time_ref/location_ref hints. An exemplar_cue value must occur verbatim inside that extraction's exact text. Use senf_coreference on each endpoint with a shared group and polarity positive or negative. Coreference is evidence only and never requests a merge.

examples.text: The professional camera arrived, but another camera stayed home.
